start: Live workout open, notifications allowed, 'Alarms & reminders' on, 'Workout sounds' on, watch connected

user_sees: Rest card in the phone's shade counting down, with 'Done', '+15 s' and 'Skip'
The rest counting down on the watch
must_not: The live workout card and the rest card side by side

steps.action: Lock the phone and wait until the rest ends
user_sees: 'Rest is over' with 'Next: <exercise>' at the end time
The chosen rest-over sound
The watch buzzes
must_not: 'Rest is over' arriving well after the rest ended
The phone's default tone instead of the chosen sound

user_sees: The old 'Rest is over' cleared
The live workout card back with the next set
must_not: An old 'Rest is over' left in the shade

start: Settings → Workouts → Rest timer and sounds, 'Alarms & reminders' off (new install on Android 14+)

user_sees: 'Rest alerts: May be late — tap to fix'
'Tap to turn on "Alarms & reminders" in your phone’s settings, so "Rest is over" rings on time'
must_not: The line shown on a phone where everything is on

steps.action: Tap the line, turn on 'Alarms & reminders', come back
user_sees: The 'Rest alerts' line gone
must_not: The line still saying May be late after the switch is on
A running rest left on the late alarm

start: Live workout, notifications on, 'Alarms & reminders' off, never asked before

steps.action: Tick a set so a rest starts
user_sees: Ask titled 'Hear "Rest is over" on time'
'Tap "Allow" to open your phone’s settings and turn on "Alarms & reminders". Then "Rest is over" rings on time, even when your phone is locked.'
'Allow' and 'Not now'
must_not: The ask when notifications are off

steps.action: Tap 'Not now', start more rests the same week
user_sees: No ask again for 7 days
'Rest alerts: Off — notifications are blocked'
'Tap to turn them on'

steps.action: Tick a set in a live workout
user_sees: The in-app rest timer still counts down
must_not: A notification permission prompt on every tick

steps.action: Tap '+15 s' on the rest card
user_sees: The countdown 15 s longer
'Rest is over' moves with it
must_not: Two 'Rest is over' alerts, the old one and the new one

user_sees: The rest card gone
No 'Rest is over' for that rest
must_not: 'Rest is over' after the rest was skipped

steps.action: Tick the last set of the workout
user_sees: After that rest: 'All sets done · Finish when ready'
must_not: 'Time for your next set' when no set is left

start: Phone locked on a gym bench during a rest

steps.action: Look at the lock screen when the rest ends
user_sees: 'Rest is over' and the next exercise's name on the lock screen
Only a buzz when 'Workout sounds' is off
must_not: Weights, body weight or notes on the lock screen
A sound when the member turned Workout sounds off
